blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Voronoi tessellations have recently emerged as an adaptive, space-partitioning discretization for shape and appearance reconstruction from multi-view images. However, the irregular cells they produce make the repeated reconstruction of the tessellation during optimization costly. We therefore explore adaptive centroidal Voronoi tessellations (CVTs), which extend standard CVTs with non-uniform cell sizes while preserving the regular, well-shaped cells that make them efficient to compute. In CVTSplat, cell size is modulated by the evolving signed distance field, concentrating sites near the zero level set while keeping cells nearly centroidal. This regularity lets us specialize the whole pipeline, with GPU algorithms for nearest-neighbor queries and approximate Voronoi construction, and a rasterizer tailored to small, nearly isotropic cells. Our Voronoi construction is 5 to 10 times faster than general-purpose alternatives in this regime. On DTU and BlendedMVS, CVTSplat reaches geometric accuracy competitive with the best Gaussian-splatting surface methods while training in about 2.5 minutes on a single GPU.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Multi-view reconstruction aims at recovering the geometry and appearance of a 3D scene from a collection of images acquired from different viewpoints. A central challenge is to design a representation that provides sufficient spatial resolution to capture fine surface details while remaining computationally efficient to optimize and render. Implicit surface methods coupled with differentiable rendering have demonstrated high reconstruction quality ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , but their practical efficiency and compactness strongly depend on how the scene volume is discretized. Uniform discretizations, such as dense voxel grids, allocate the same capacity throughout space even though accurate geometry and appearance are primarily required near the reconstructed surface. Conversely, adaptive representations concentrate capacity in relevant regions, but introduce irregular spatial configurations that can make neighborhood queries, geometric operations, and rendering more expensive.
blocks.zh: 多景重建旨在从从不同观点获取的图像集合中恢复3D场景的几何和外观. 一个中心挑战是设计一种能提供足够的空间分辨率来捕捉精细的表面细节的表示,同时保持计算效率以优化和渲染. 隐含的表面方法加上不同的渲染方法,已经显示出了高的重建质量(Wang等人,2021年),但其实际效率和紧凑性强烈取决于场景量是如何被磁盘化的. 尽管在重建的表面附近主要需要准确的几何和外观,但统一圆盘化,如密集的voxel网格,在整个空间分配同样的容量. 反之,适应性表述将能力集中在相关区域,但引入了不规则的空间配置,可以使邻里查询,几何操作,并使成本更高.

blocks.en: Voronoi-based representations provide an interesting direction for addressing this trade-off. Recent works have explored Voronoi and related cellular discretizations for neural rendering and reconstruction ( Govindarajan et al., 2025 ; Govindarajan et al., 2026 ; Rech et al., 2026 ; Mai et al., 2026 ; Taveira et al., 2026b ; Weidenfeller et al., 2026 ) . However, these representations do not explicitly exploit one of the fundamental properties of Centroidal Voronoi Tessellations (CVTs): their tendency to produce regular, well-shaped cells. Such regularity is particularly attractive computationally, since irregular Voronoi cells may require visiting many neighboring sites when constructing the diagram ( Ray et al., 2018 ) . At the same time, a standard CVT tends toward a uniform distribution of sites, thereby losing the main benefit of an adaptive representation.
blocks.zh: 以沃罗诺伊语为基础的表述为处理这种权衡提供了一个有趣的方向。 近期的作品探索了沃罗诺伊和相关的细胞盘片化,用于神经渲染和重建(Govindarajan等人,2025年;Govindarajan等人,2026年;Rech等人,2026年;Mai等人,2026年;Taveira等人,2026年b;Weidenfeller等人,2026年). 然而,这些表示法并没有明确地利用Centroidal Voronoi Tessellations(CVTs)的基本特性之一:它们倾向于产生固定的,形状良好的细胞. 这种规律性在计算上特别有吸引力,因为不规则的沃罗诺伊细胞在构建图时可能需要访问许多邻近地点(Ray等人,2018年). 同时,标准的CVT倾向于统一分布场地,从而失去了适应性代表的主要好处.

blocks.en: We therefore investigate adaptive centroidal Voronoi tessellations as a spatial representation for multi-view reconstruction. We modulate cell size using the implicit surface, yielding a near-centroidal tessellation with increased site density around the zero level set (fig. 1 ). This combines the representational efficiency of an adaptive discretization with the computational benefits of regular Voronoi cells, while relying on a standard Voronoi diagram rather than a power diagram. Specifically, power diagrams offer another way to achieve adaptivity, but require an additional weight per site and incur a higher construction cost ( Govindarajan et al., 2026 ; Taveira et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们调查适应性中间行星Voronii星座,作为多景重建的空间代表。 我们利用隐含的表面来调节细胞大小,产生近中心机器人的切变,在零水平集周围增加场地密度(图1)。 这结合了适应性磁盘化的表达效率与普通Voronoi细胞的计算效益,同时依赖于标准Voronoi图而不是动力图. 具体来说,动力图为实现适配性提供了另一种方法,但要求每个场地增加重量,并产生较高的建筑成本(Govindarajan等人,2026年;Taveira等人,2026年a) 。 。 。

blocks.en: The complete optimization pipeline is described in figure 2 . It consists of two components: the adaptive tessellation controls the position of the sites, while the differentiable rendering branch optimizes the signed-distance and appearance attributes. The tessellation is guided by the evolving implicit surface to produce a surface-adaptive discretization. Our main contributions are as follows:

blocks.en: (1) We introduce an adaptive centroidal Voronoi discretization for multi-view reconstruction, combining surface adaptivity with the regularity of centroidal tessellations. Our complete reconstruction pipeline achieves geometric accuracy competitive with state-of-the-art 3DGS-based methods ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Gomez et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) on DTU, while training in approximately 2.5 minutes on a single RTX 5090 and using 4 GB of VRAM. (2) We exploit the regularity of the tessellation to make Voronoi-based reconstruction computationally efficient. We introduce specialized GPU algorithms for approximate Voronoi construction, repeated K K -nearest-neighbor queries, and Delaunay triangulation, substantially accelerating these operations compared to general-purpose approaches ( Ray et al., 2018 ; Basselin et al., 2021 ; Cao et al., 2014 ; Taveira et al., 2026a ; Govindarajan et al., 2025 ) . (3) We propose a rasterizer optimized for rendering small, isotropic primitives, further consolidating our framework.

blocks.en: Figure 2. Overview of our approach during optimization. Top row: Construction of the tessellation. (a) The sites are processed to obtain a list of their 32 nearest neighbors, (b) before building the Voronoi diagram as an adjacency graph. (c) The center of mass of each cell is then computed to regularize the distribution of the sites via the CVT loss. (d) The Voronoi diagram is optionally converted to a Delaunay triangulation to extract the zero-level set with marching tetrahedra. Bottom row: Differentiable volume rendering from posed images. (e) The sites’ attributes (learnable SDF and features) are smoothed with a Gaussian kernel. (f) The gradient of the SDF is also computed to produce normal vectors, which define a piecewise linear SDF over the cells. Then, for all viewpoints in the mini-batch, (g) a per-site color is computed based on the camera’s position, (h) before rasterizing the scene and comparing against the ground-truth image.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: We review the literature most closely related to our approach along three directions: adaptive spatial discretizations for implicit 3D reconstruction (Sec. 2.1 ), explicit primitive-based representations (Sec. 2.2 ), and efficient GPU construction of 3D Voronoi and Delaunay diagrams (Sec. 2.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们沿着三个方向审查与我们的方法最密切相关的文献:用于暗含3D重建的适应性空间盘点(Sec 2.1),基于原始的明确表示(Sec 2.2),以及高效的GPU构建3D Voronoi和Delaunay图(Sec 2. 3).

blocks.en: 2.1. Adaptive Spatial Discretizations
blocks.zh: 2.1. 适应性的空间分裂

blocks.en: Multi-view 3D reconstruction based on differentiable rendering initially relied on continuous neural representations ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) , before increasingly adopting grid-based or hybrid spatial encodings to accelerate optimization and rendering ( Fridovich-Keil et al., 2022 ; Müller et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2020 ; Toussaint et al., 2025 ) . The main objective of these representations is to allocate computation sparsely, by concentrating capacity around the reconstructed surface. However, grid-aligned discretizations typically follow a predefined spatial structure that either stays fixed during optimization or changes discretely across levels of detail.
blocks.zh: 多视图基于不同渲染的立体重建最初依赖于连续神经表达(Mildenhall等人,2021年;Wang等人,2021年),然后越来越多地采用网格或混合空间编码来加速优化和渲染(Fridovich-Keil等人,2022年;Müller等人,2022年;Chen等人,2022年;Liu等人,2020年;Toussaint等人,2025年). 这些表述的主要目的是通过将能力集中到重建的表面来进行稀释的计算。 然而,网格对齐的盘旋通常遵循预先定义的空间结构,这种结构要么在优化期间保持固定,要么在细节级别上独立变化。

blocks.en:
Unstructured discretizations offer greater flexibility in adapting both the number and spatial extent of their elements. Recent approaches have explored Voronoi or Power cells ( Govindarajan et al., 2025 ; Govindarajan et al., 2026 ; Rech et al., 2026 ; Taveira et al., 2026b ) , as well as tetrahedral representations ( Thomas et al., 2025 ; Kulhanek and Sattler, 2023 ; Mai et al., 2026 ; Weidenfeller et al., 2026 ) .
These works motivate spatial representations that retain the flexibility of unstructured discretizations while achieving the accuracy and efficiency of highly optimized grid-based methods.
blocks.zh:
非结构化的圆盘化在调整其元素的数量和空间范围方面提供了更大的灵活性。 最近的方法探索了沃罗诺伊或动力细胞(Govindarajan等人,2025年;Govindarajan等人,2026年;Rech等人,2026年;Taveira等人,2026年b),以及四面体表达法。 (Thomas等人,2025年;Kulhanek和Sattler,2023年;Mai等人,2026年;Weidenfeller等人,2026年).
这些作品激发了空间表示,保留了非结构化的盘片化的灵活性,同时实现了高度优化的网格方法的准确性和效率.

blocks.en: 2.2. Explicit Splatting Representations
blocks.zh: 2.2. 明确的招牌

blocks.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) has become a widely used representation for high-quality novel-view synthesis due to its adaptive distribution of primitives and efficient rasterization. However, recovering coherent geometry from an unstructured set of Gaussians is highly challenging ( Guédon and Lepetit, 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Radl et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Guédon et al., 2025 ; Gomez et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Existing methods introduce additional constraints or regularization to suppress floaters and improve depth and normal consistency ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , or dedicated procedures for extracting closed surfaces ( Guédon et al., 2025 ; Gomez et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 3D Gaussian Splating(Kerbl等人,2023年)因其适应性地分布原始物和高效的光栅化而成为了高质量小说-视觉合成广泛使用的代表. 然而,从一组无结构的高斯人中恢复连贯的几何特征具有很大挑战性(Guédon and Lepetit,2024;Huang等人,2024;Yu等人,2024;Radl等人,2025;Chen等人,2024;Guédon等人,2025;Gomez等人,2026;Zhang等人,2026b)。 现有方法引入了额外的约束或规范,以压制浮体,提高深度和正常一致性(Chen等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2026年b),或提取封闭表面的专用程序(Guédon等人,2025年;Gomez等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Space-partitioning primitives such as tetrahedra and Voronoi cells provide an alternative splat support ( Govindarajan et al., 2025 ; Mai et al., 2026 ) in which neighboring elements form a coherent spatial decomposition rather than an overlapping collection of primitives. This structure provides consistent spatial ordering, but maintaining it while the underlying sites move during optimization can introduce considerable computational overhead. Efficiently updating such adaptive representations therefore remains an important challenge.
blocks.zh: 四赫德拉和沃罗诺伊细胞等空间分化原始物提供了替代的石板支撑(Govindarajan等人,2025年;Mai等人,2026年),其中相邻元素组成了连贯的空间分解而非重叠的原始物集合. 这种结构提供一致的空间顺序,但是在基础站点在优化期间移动时加以维护,可以引入大量的计算间接费用. 因此,有效更新这种适应性表述仍然是一个重大挑战。

blocks.en: 2.3. GPU Voronoi & Delaunay Diagrams Construction
blocks.zh: 2.3. GPU Voronoi & Delaunay图表建筑公司

blocks.en: A 3D Voronoi diagram can be represented through its adjacency graph, i.e., the neighboring relationships between generating sites. This graph can be recovered indirectly through the dual Delaunay triangulation ( Govindarajan et al., 2025 ) , or computed directly from the Voronoi cells. GPU Delaunay algorithms enable substantial parallelism ( Cao et al., 2014 ; Govindarajan et al., 2025 ) , but generally require multiple rounds of point insertion, tetrahedron splitting, flipping, and repair, making frequent reconstruction of a dynamically evolving diagram costly.
blocks.zh: 3D Voronii图可以通过它的附图来表示,即生成站点之间的邻接关系. 这个图可以通过双重Delaunay三角法(Govindarajan等人,2025年)间接回收,或直接从沃罗诺伊细胞中计算. GPU Delaunay算法可以实现实质性的平行性(Cao等人,2014年;Govindarajan等人,2025年),但一般需要多轮插入点,四面体分裂,翻转和修复,使得频繁重建动态演化的图表代价高昂.

blocks.en: GPU methods for direct Voronoi construction were initially developed for relatively uniform point distributions ( Ray et al., 2018 ; Basselin et al., 2021 ) , providing large speedups over CPU implementations ( The CGAL Project, 2026 ; Lévy, 2026 ) . More recently, Taveira et al. ( Taveira et al., 2026a ) extended this family of approaches to non-uniform point distributions. Following the clipping formulation of Ray et al. ( Ray et al., 2018 ) , Voronoi cells are constructed independently by successively clipping them against bisector planes induced by neighboring sites. Although cells can be processed in parallel, the clipping operations for each cell are sequential, and irregular cells may require significantly more operations. Leaving cells unregularized ( Govindarajan et al., 2025 ) can thereby increase the total construction cost.

blocks.en: 3. Fast and Adaptive Spatial Data Structure
blocks.zh: 3个 快速和适应性空间数据结构

blocks.en: Our spatial representation consists of a set of sites { 𝐱 i } 0 ≤ i < N \{\mathbf{x}_{i}\}_{0\leq i<N} ( i.e. 3D points) that induce a Voronoi tessellation of the scene volume. Each site stores the geometric and appearance attributes used by the reconstruction, including a signed-distance value and view-dependent radiance features. The Voronoi cells provide the volumetric primitives used for rendering, while their dual Delaunay connectivity provides the local neighborhood structure required for mesh extraction. Because the site positions evolve throughout optimization, these structures must be updated repeatedly. A key property of our representation is that the sites remain close to a centroidal configuration, producing compact cells with a small number of nearby neighbors and enabling efficient GPU construction.
blocks.zh: 我们的空间表示由一组站点 {x i } 0 ≤ i < N \{\ mathbf{x}_{i}\}_{0\leq i <N }(即3D点) , 诱导对场景音量的 Voronii 切换 。 每个站点存储重建所使用的几何和外观属性,包括一个签名-距离值和视线依赖的光度特征. Voronoi细胞提供用于渲染的体积原始物,而它们的双重Delaunay连通性提供了网状提取所需的局部邻里结构. 由于站点位置在整个优化过程中不断演变,这些结构必须反复更新. 我们代表的一个重要财产是,这些场地仍然靠近一个中心行星的布局,与附近少数邻居产生紧凑的细胞,并促成高效的GPU建设.

blocks.en: In the following, we first describe how we obtain this adaptive centroidal distribution (Sec. 3.1 ) and compute its centroids (Sec. 3.2 ). We then present our fast Voronoi construction (Sec. 3.3 ), its conversion to Delaunay tetrahedra (Sec. 3.4 ), and the KNN kernel supporting these operations (Sec. 3.5 ).

In a centroidal Voronoi tessellation (CVT), the sites 𝐱 i \mathbf{x}_{i} coincide with the center of mass 𝐱 ¯ i \bar{\mathbf{x}}_{i} of their cell (the centroids). It is not the case at first because the sites have arbitrary positions, but iteratively minimizing the CVT loss ℒ CVT = ∑ ‖ 𝐱 i − 𝐱 ¯ i ‖ 2 \mathcal{L}_{\text{CVT}}=\sum||\mathbf{x}_{i}-\bar{\mathbf{x}}_{i}||^{2} brings the tessellation closer to being centroidal, with regular cells ( Lloyd, 1982 ) . Since we need an adaptive distribution rather than a uniform one, we propose to bias this loss using the normal vector of the SDF (see figure 3 ). Our biased CVT loss is as follows: (1) ℒ CVT \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\text{CVT}} = ∑ i 1 sg ⁡ ( r i ) ​ ‖ 𝐱 i − sg ⁡ ( 𝐱 ¯ i − β i ​ r i ​ 𝐧 i ) ‖ 2 2 . \displaystyle=\sum_{i}\frac{1}{\operatorname{sg}\!\left(r_{i}\right)}||\mathbf{x}_{i}-\operatorname{sg}\!\left(\bar{\mathbf{x}}_{i}-\beta_{i}r_{i}\mathbf{n}_{i}\right)||_{2}^{2}. sg ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \operatorname{sg}\!\left(\cdot\right) is the stop-gradient operator and r i r_{i} is the radius of the cell. Adaptivity may also be achieved using a spatially-varying mass density when computing cell moments ( Du et al., 1999 ) but our approach is more direct. Intuitively, the centroid 𝐱 ¯ i \bar{\mathbf{x}}_{i} is offset by a fraction β i \beta_{i} of the cell radius along the SDF gradient 𝐧 i \mathbf{n}_{i} . We divide by r i r_{i} to make the loss scale-invariant. β i \beta_{i} directly depends on the SDF f ^ i \hat{f}_{i} : (2) β i \displaystyle\beta_{i} = a ⋅ tanh ⁡ ( f ^ i 2 ​ b ) . \displaystyle=a\cdot\tanh(\frac{\hat{f}_{i}}{2b}). a , b > 0 a,b>0 control the magnitude of the shift. Using a = 0 a=0 gives the standard centroidal tessellation. In our experiments, we set a = 0.1 a=0.1 and b = 0.001 b=0.001 which corresponds to shifting the centroid by 10 % 10\% of the cell radius. This results in smaller cells near the zero level-set and larger cells further away, with cell radius growing approximately linearly with SDF (refer to the supplementary material for an empirical analysis).
The size of the cells is not explicitly imposed, which lets them arrange themselves independently of their number and of the object’s surface area.

blocks.en: Following previous GPU approaches ( Ray et al., 2018 ; Basselin et al., 2021 ; Taveira et al., 2026a ) , we represent the Voronoi diagram as an adjacency graph. However, we propose a new algorithm designed specifically for near-centroidal distributions. We assume the sites are in general position as a simplification, this means there are no duplicates and five sites or more are not cospherical.
blocks.zh: 按照以前的GPU方法(Ray等人,2018年;Basselin等人,2021年;Taveira等人,2026a年),我们代表沃罗诺伊图作为附图. 然而,我们提出一种专门为近中心行星分布量设计的新的算法. 我们假设这些地点一般处于简化状态,这意味着没有重复,五个或更多地点不是地层。

blocks.en: We test feasibility with Seidel’s incremental algorithm ( Seidel, 1991 ; Anupam and Danny, 2016 ) , which maintains a feasible point and updates it only when a new constraint is violated, by solving a 1D problem along that constraint’s boundary line. Instead of shuffling the constraints randomly, we process them in increasing distance order, as returned by the KNN kernel (Sec. 3.5 ). The nearest planes are the most likely to bound the cell, so infeasibility is usually detected early.

blocks.en: We consider that only the 32 nearest neighbors are likely to define active bisector planes, so there are 32 threads dedicated for building each cell. Each one tests a candidate plane 𝒫 r \mathcal{P}_{r} against the 37 remaining constraints (31 other neighbors and the 6 planes of the scene bounding box). The 2D constraints are built on the fly from the site positions so no per-thread storage is needed, which is a significant bottleneck in previous approaches ( Ray et al., 2018 ; Basselin et al., 2021 ) due to reduced GPU occupancy. At the end, each thread outputs a single bit classifying whether the neighbor is Voronoi-adjacent.

blocks.en:
The assumption that 32 neighbors are enough generally holds in the case of our biased CVT. To further reduce the number of missing adjacencies, we center the KNN queries at the previously computed cell centroids rather than at the sites themselves. This substantially improves the completeness of the resulting Voronoi diagrams, as demonstrated in the supplementary material.
More neighbors could be included to handle more irregular cells, though with a performance loss. If a true neighbor beyond the K K nearest sites is missed, the cell will be enlarged and will overlap its neighbor. A missing constraint can also enlarge the feasible region of Eq. ( 15 ), so that a non-neighbor is wrongly marked as adjacent. Both errors are local and only affect cells near the few sites concerned.

blocks.en: 3.5. Fast GPU KNN Search
blocks.zh: 3.5. 快速GPU KNN搜索

blocks.en: We propose a fast K-nearest neighbor kernel, tailored for K = 32 K=32 and for repeated queries, to take advantage of our specific setting: the sites move by small amounts between rebuilds of the nearest-neighbors lists, which implies a high degree of temporal consistency that can be leveraged. Like Jakob et al. ( Jakob and Guthe, 2021 ) , we start by building an acceleration structure to avoid a naive O ⁡ ( N 2 ) O(N^{2}) brute force check. We use a classic LBVH ( Lauterbach et al., 2009 ) with up to 128 points per node. This gives a shallow hierarchy well-suited for querying a relatively large number of neighbors.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个快速的K-近邻内核,适合K=32K=32和重复询问,以利用我们的具体设置:地点在最近邻列表的重建之间以小量移动,这意味着可以利用的高度时间一致性. 如贾科布等. (Jakob and Guthe, 2021),我们首先建立一个加速结构,以避免天真的O Q(N 2)O(N^{2)野蛮的力量检查. 我们使用经典的LBVH(劳特巴赫等人,2009年),每个节点最高可达128分. 这使得比较浅的等级结构很适合查询相对数量较多的邻居.

blocks.en: The nearest neighbors are gathered using ball-queries, i.e. gathering all points within some distance of the query point, instead of the more common heap-based approach ( Jakob and Guthe, 2021 ; Ray et al., 2018 ) . The ball-query is restarted with a smaller or larger radius until the number of gathered points is between 32 and 64, using a binary search. They are subsequently sorted in increasing distance to the query point ( NVIDIA Corporation, 2026 ) and the first 32 are returned. Each query point has its own search radius which we save for later runs. The point cloud evolves slowly so the search radius is likely to be valid the next time the KNN routine is called, sparing repeated BVH traversals.
blocks.zh: 距离最近的邻居使用球点来收集,即收集所有点数在查询点的一定距离内,而不是更常见的堆积法(Jakob and Guthe, 2021; Ray et al., 2018). 球射线以较小或更大的半径重启,直到集合点数在32到64之间,使用二进制搜索. 它们随后被排序在越来越远的距离到查询点(NVIDIA Corporation,2026),前32个返回. 每个查询点都有自己的搜索半径,我们保存用于以后的运行. 点云演化缓慢,所以在下一次调用KNN常规时,搜索半径很可能是有效的,省去了重复的BVH转录.

blocks.en: Heap-based approaches generally assign one thread per query point, and therefore need a per-thread traversal stack or priority queue, in addition to the heap already required to keep track of the K closest points. While the heap can be stored in registers ( Jakob and Guthe, 2021 ) , this reduces occupancy considerably for large values of K or spills the registers to global memory.
blocks.zh: 基于堆肥的方法一般每个查询点都指定一个线程,因此除了已经需要的堆肥外,还需要每个线程的traversal堆栈或优先排队来跟踪K最接近的点. 虽然堆积可以存放在登记册中(Jakob and Guthe, 2021年),但这大大降低了K大值的占用量或将登记册溢到全球记忆中.

blocks.en:
Our strategy addresses these issues: we assign one warp per query point, with all lanes visiting the BVH together. A single BVH traversal stack is needed for the whole warp, and the points can be loaded with coalesced memory accesses.
The points within the search radius are compacted to a shared memory buffer sorted in parallel at the end, which is faster than iterative heap insertions.
blocks.zh:
我们的战略是处理这些问题:我们每个查询点分配一个曲速,所有通道一起访问波黑。 整个曲速需要单一的BVH traversal堆栈,各点可以加载连接的内存访问器.
搜索半径内的点被压缩成一个共享内存缓冲器,在结尾平行排序,比迭代堆积插入更快.

blocks.en: 4. Differentiable Volume Rendering
blocks.zh: 4个 可分量渲染

blocks.en:
After gathering the nearest neighbors of all sites and computing the Voronoi diagram, we can proceed with rendering of the scene.
The volume rendering integral is typically evaluated with ray-marching ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) , by querying the radiance and density fields at arbitrary locations along the rays. Directly adopting this formulation for our discretization is ill-suited: interpolating point neighborhoods at each ray sample is costly ( Xu et al., 2022 ) , while interpolating over the Voronoi cells generally requires a tetrahedral mesh ( Thomas et al., 2025 ; Mai et al., 2026 ) . Instead, we follow RadiantFoam ( Govindarajan et al., 2025 ) and use piecewise integration where each cell only contributes to the portion of the ray it intersects. RadiantFoam ( Govindarajan et al., 2025 ) and SDFoam ( Rech et al., 2026 ) use a constant density inside the cells which does not account for local surface orientation. In comparison, we define the SDF as a linear function in each cell to obtain nonlinearities once composed with NeuS ( Wang et al., 2021 ) ’s SDF-to-density conversion, and which crucially still gives a closed-form solution to the volume integral over the ray segments.

blocks.en:
Three elements are necessary: (i) the SDF gradient at each site to define a piecewise SDF, (ii) per-primitive radiance and (iii) regularization terms to stabilize optimization. We reuse the nearest neighbors gathered during the Voronoi diagram construction (section 3.5 ) to regularize the sites’ attributes and to compute the SDF gradient.
For view-dependent appearance, we favor a neural implicit approach instead of per-site spherical harmonics to reduce the number of appearance parameters, as explained in section 4.2 . Finally, section 4.3 covers our rasterization algorithm designed for small primitives.

blocks.en: We assign a view-dependent color to each cell 𝒞 i \mathcal{C}_{i} to model the scene appearance. Like 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) , the color is constant inside a primitive, which gives a piecewise constant color field in our case. Our appearance parametrization takes inspiration from ( Toussaint et al., 2025 ) . The main idea is to split view-independent components ( e.g. texture) from view-dependent components of the light field ( e.g. shading) to significantly reduce the number of parameters compared to a distinct spherical harmonic (SH) basis per primitive.
blocks.zh: 我们为每个单元格 C i\ mathcal{C}_{i} 指定一个视线依赖的颜色来建模场景外观 。 和3DGS(Kerbl等人,2023年)一样,颜色在原始体内是恒定的,这给我们的情况提供了一块恒定的色域. 我们的外表被美化(Toussaint等人,2025年)所启发。 主要思想是将独立视图的组件(如纹理)从光场的依赖视图的组件(如阴影)中分离出来,与每个原始的鲜明球形口音(SH)基础相比,显著减少参数数量.

blocks.en: 4.3.1. Chunked Rasterizer

We noticed using one thread per ray results in poor GPU utilization whenever some rays intersect more cells than the average, which occurs for grazing rays that are parallel to the surface. In the worst case, a single thread can keep the GPU busy while the rest have terminated long before.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,当一些射线与平均射线相交时,每条射线使用一线会导致GPU利用率差,这发生在与表面平行的放牧射线上。 在最糟糕的情况下,单线可以让GPU保持繁忙,而其余的则在很早之前就终止了.

blocks.en: Figure 9. The pixel tiles are split into chunks of 32 consecutive cells. All chunks are rasterized in parallel but the ones marked in red have been skipped by detecting occlusions dynamically. The final result (top left) is the α \alpha -blending of all the chunks in front-to-back order, evaluated in a subsequent pass.
blocks.zh: 图 9. 像素瓦片分为32个连续细胞块。 所有块都是平行的光栅化的,但用红色标记的块则通过动态地检测隔离而跳过。 最终结果(左上方)是 α\ alpha - 将所有块按前向后排列, 并在随后的通过中进行评估 。

blocks.en: Thus, we propose to split the sum in equation 33 into contiguous ranges of 32 cells that we call chunks, with the goal of increasing parallelism during rasterization.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们建议将方程式33中的总和分成我们称之为块的32个细胞的毗连范围,目的是在光栅化过程中增加平行性。

blocks.en: As figure 9 shows, all chunks are scheduled to be processed in parallel, with chunks closer to the camera being handled first since we order them front-to-back. Naively processing the chunks all at once is not ideal because occluded cells would still be intersected and blended. In comparison, a sequential processing can exit as soon as the per-ray transmittance reaches zero. To retain this useful behavior, we propose a communication system based on per-pixel flags that are updated atomically by the chunks when they terminate their local rasterization task.
blocks.zh: 如图9所示,所有块被安排为平行处理,离相机更近的块被首先处理,因为我们先订购它们。 自然地同时处理这些块并不理想,因为被吞噬的细胞仍然会交叉和混合. 相比之下,一个顺序处理可以在每盘射线传输达到零后立即退出. 为了保留这种有用的行为,我们提议一个基于每像素旗帜的通讯系统,当块结束其局部光栅化任务时,这个系统在原子上被块更新.

The accumulator T c T_{c} is an upper bound of the true transmittance up to chunk D c D_{c} , valid for all chunks with depth index i ≥ D c i\geq D_{c} . blocks.en: The main cost in evaluating equation 33 is the computation of the ray/cell intersection intervals ( t i − , t i + ) (t_{i}^{-},t_{i}^{+}) due to execution divergence: each ray intersects a different subset of cells. To reduce this cost, we let threads work on different cells concurrently. The alternative is to iterate over the cells sequentially, and only the threads whose ray intersects the current cell can make progress while the others are inactive. For a given chunk, we first load the attributes of its 32 cells cooperatively in shared memory.
blocks.zh: 评价方程式33的主要成本是计算射线/细胞的交叉间隔(t i −, t i + ) (t _{i}^{-}, t_{i}^{+})由于执行差异:每个射线交叉一个不同的细胞子集. 为了降低这一成本,我们让线程同时在不同的细胞上工作。 替代办法是依次在细胞上斜拉,只有射线与电流细胞相交的线程才能在其它不活动时取得进展. 对于给定的块,我们首先在共享内存中合作加载其32个细胞的属性.

blocks.en: Then, each thread performs a ray/sphere intersection test ( Haines et al., 2019 ) against the cells’ bounding spheres, which produces a bit mask with one bit per cell. This part is sequential but relatively inexpensive. Next, each thread iterates over the bits set in its intersection mask and performs the more expensive ray/cell check against the corresponding cell, which need not be the same for all threads. The maximum number of bits set in the mask across threads determines the total number of iterations, often lower than 32 32 since a ray is unlikely to intersect all cells’ bounding spheres in the chunk. This optimization makes sense in our case because the cells are only a few pixels across and intersection tests are costly. Larger primitives would not benefit as much because more rays intersect them at once, and thus incur lower execution divergence.
blocks.zh: 之后,每个线程都会对细胞的束缚球面进行射线/圈的交叉测试(Haines等人,2019年),这些球面会产生一个带1位细胞的点罩. 这一部分是相继进行的,但费用相对较低。 接下来,每个线程在它的交叉面罩中设置的位数上延展,并进行比较昂贵的射线/细胞对对应的细胞的检查,对于所有线程来说,这不一定是相同的. 遮罩中设定的最大位数跨线决定了迭代的总数,往往低于32 32,因为射线不太可能在块中交叉所有细胞的连接域. 这种优化对我们来说是有道理的,因为细胞只是几个像素,交叉测试成本很高。 较大的原始人不会得到如此大的好处,因为更多的射线一次交叉,从而产生较低的执行差异.

blocks.en: Initially, we spread the sites in the scene bounding box based on a uniform distribution and apply 10 iterations of Lloyd’s relaxation to uniformize the cells ( a = 0 a=0 in equation 1 ). The SDF is initialized from a sphere, while the rest of the learnable features are randomized based on a normal distribution.

blocks.en: We start with 200K sites, and increase their number every 10 iterations until we reach 4M sites by following a geometric progression. To place new sites, we pick a random viewpoint and render a depth map and a feature map. The feature map is the α \alpha -blending of the sites’ spatial features 𝐅 s \mathbf{F}^{s} . A new site is placed at the depth sampled from a random valid pixel in the depth map, and its feature vector 𝐅 s \mathbf{F}^{s} is sampled from the same pixel in the feature map.
blocks.zh: 我们从200K站点开始,每10个迭代增加一个站点的数量,直到我们通过几何进展到达4M站点。 为了放置新的站点,我们选择一个随机的视角,并制作深度地图和特征地图。 特征图是 α\ alpha - 混合网站的空间特征 F s\ mathbf{F}^{s} 。 在从深度图中随机有效的像素取样的深度处放置了一个新站点,其特征矢量F s\mathbf{F}^{s}从特征图中相同的像素取样.

blocks.en: The nearest-neighbors list is rebuilt each time new points are added, while the Voronoi diagram is recomputed more frequently: at each iteration in the beginning, and every five iterations towards the end. We train for 10K iterations, with four training images per mini-batch. New points are added starting from the 400th iteration, until the last 400 iterations. For the last 400 iterations, we replace the planar-based ZNCC with a nonplanar version to avoid suppressing fine-scale details. More details regarding the multi-view loss and the weight scheduling are given in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 最近的邻居列表每次增加新点时都会重建,而沃罗诺伊图则会更频繁地重编:在开头的每个迭代,在接近结尾时每五个迭代. 我们为10K重排训练,每个小批量四个训练图像. 从第400次迭代开始,到最后的400次迭代,新增点数. 对于最后的400个迭代,我们用非普兰卡版本取代了基于普兰卡的ZNCC,以避免压制细级的细节. 关于多视图损失和加权表的更多详情见补充材料。

blocks.en: 6. Experimental validation
blocks.zh: 6个 实验验证

blocks.en: All experiments in this section used a workstation equipped with an RTX 5090 GPU and an Intel Core Ultra 7 265K with 20 cores to measure timings, with the exception of table 2 where we report each method’s timing and corresponding hardware configuration. Best , second and third best results are highlighted in the tables.
blocks.zh: 本节中的所有实验都使用了配备一台RTX 5090 GPU和一台Intel Core 7 265K的具有20个核心的工作站来测量时间,但表2除外,我们报告每种方法的时间和相应的硬件配置. 各表突出列出最佳、第二和第三个最佳结果。

blocks.en: 6.1. Multi-view Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 6.1. 多观点重建

blocks.en: Evaluation on DTU. We evaluate the multi-view reconstruction accuracy of our approach on 15 scenes from the DTU dataset ( Aanæs et al., 2016 ) . Quantitative results are reported in table 2 and qualitative results are shown in figure 10 . We achieve state-of-the-art geometric accuracy, tied with GGGS ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) and BlobsToSpokes ( Gomez et al., 2026 ) , while requiring a training time of approximately 2.5 minutes. Our approach reproduces high-frequency geometric details that GGGS and BlobsToSpokes miss, this is particularly noticeable in the close-ups on scans 24 and 106 shown at the top of fig. 10 . We hypothesize the qualitative improvement does not lead to quantitative improvement due to noise in the ground truth point clouds and down-sampling of the input reconstructions by the official evaluation script.
blocks.zh: 对DTU的评价. 从DTU数据集(Aanæs et al., 2016年), 表2报告了量化结果,图10显示了质量结果。 我们实现了最先进的几何精度,与GGGS(Zhang等人,2026年b)和BlobsToSpokes(Gomez等人,2026年b)捆绑在一起,同时需要大约2.5分钟的训练时间. 我们的方法复制了GGGS和BlobsToSpokes错过的高频几何细节,这一点在扫描24和106的特写中特别明显,在无花果顶部显示. 10,我们假设质量改进不会导致数量上的改进,因为地面真理点云的噪音和通过官方评价脚本对输入重建进行下取样.

blocks.en: For consistency with the 3DGS-like approaches ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , we discard vertices that project outside of the training masks as well as hidden vertices before Chamfer distance evaluation, since closed surfaces tend to be penalized under the DTU evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 为了与3DGS类似方法(Huang等人,2024年)保持一致,我们在Chamfer距离评价之前,抛弃了训练口罩外的项目的顶点以及隐藏顶点,因为封闭的表面往往根据DTU评价协议受到处罚.

blocks.en: Evaluation on BlendedMVS. We also compare our approach on 8 scenes from the BlendedMVS ( Yao et al., 2020 ) dataset in table 1 , with qualitative results presented in figure 11 . We measure Chamfer distances as point-to-mesh distances in the normalized reference frame used for training, with the same evaluation protocol on this dataset as ProbeSDF ( Toussaint et al., 2025 ) . The images were cropped before running PGSR and GGGS according to the 2DGS protocol ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , since they require a projection center in the middle of the images. We achieve high geometric accuracy using the same hyperparameters as on DTU, with GGGS slightly ahead quantitatively but with noticeable noise (see figure 11 ). PGSR fails to produce a mesh in two instances due to ambiguous white backgrounds which caused the GPU to run out of memory during mesh extraction.
blocks.zh: BlendedMVS的评价. 我们还比较了表1中的BlendedMVS(姚等人,2020年)数据集中的8场景,并将质量结果见图11。 我们测量Chamfer距离是用于培训的标准化参考框架中的点对点距离,对该数据集的评价协议与ProbeSDF相同(Toussaint等人,2025年)。 根据2DGS协议(Huang等人,2024年),这些图像在运行PGSR和GGGS之前被裁剪,因为它们需要在图像中间有一个投影中心. 我们使用与DTU相同的超参数实现高几何精度,GGS在数量上略高于,但有明显的噪音(见图11)。 PGSR 两次无法产生网格,因为模糊的白色背景导致GPU在网格提取过程中内存耗尽.

Reducing either of these produces a small decrease in accuracy but lowers training time substantially. Qualitative results are shown in figure 12 .

blocks.en: Next, using the chunked rasterizer described in section 4.3.1 has the largest impact on runtime: the optimization takes 147 147 s with it, compared to 280 280 s using a baseline that assigns a single GPU thread per pixel similarly to 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) . This almost gives a 2 × 2\times speedup on the end-to-end optimization. Both rasterizers achieve nearly the same Chamfer distance and the remaining discrepancy can likely be attributed to differences in floating-point arithmetic.

blocks.en: 6.3. Ablations on DTU
blocks.zh: 6.3. 对DTU的限制

blocks.en: We ablate our losses and regularization terms in table 4 , ordered by decreasing importance. Figure 13 compares against the base model qualitatively. Training using a linear radiance tone-mapped after rasterization, compared to a typical sigmoid-bounded nonlinear radiance, avoids a failure case on scan 65 due to large patches of saturated pixels, but makes little difference otherwise. Removing the multi-view loss (No ZNCC) or the depth smoothing loss has a strong impact overall. Setting a = 0.05 a=0.05 in the biased CVT loss (eq. 1 ), instead of a = 0.10 a=0.10 prevents the cells from shrinking sufficiently which reduces accuracy but does not create hard failure cases. The reflection probes are important for recovering smooth geometry in specular regions (scan 110, 69). Adding an environment map helps compensating for slight inaccuracies in the supervision masks (scan 83). The rest of the components have lower importance: the SSIM, color correction curves and view probes are added for robustness against inconsistent illumination conditions. Removing one of them does not affect geometry meaningfully. Finishing training with the non planar ZNCC term instead of the planar ZNCC gives a qualitative improvement in fine details (scan 106). Finally, removing the normal smoothing term (eq. 24 ) slightly improves the Chamfer distance compared to our base model but also introduces artifacts (scan 110). The gradient modulation (eq. 44 ) does not change the end result but makes training more stable.
blocks.zh: 我们减少损失,减少表4中的正规化条件。 图13与基准模型进行了质量比较。 使用光栅化后的线性光度调图来进行训练,与典型的西格莫德捆绑的非线性光度相比,由于饱和像素大补丁,避免了扫描65上的故障,但除此之外没有什么区别. 移除多视图损失(无 ZNCC)或深度平滑损失总体影响很大. 在偏差的CVT损失(eq. 1)中设置一个= 0.05 a= 0.05,而不是一个= 0.10 a=0.10 防止单元格足够缩小,从而降低精度,但不会产生硬故障。 反射探测器对恢复光谱区平滑几何(扫描110,69)很重要. 增加一张环境图有助于弥补监督口罩(扫描83)中略微不准确之处。 其他组件的重要性较低:增加了SSIM,色彩校正曲线和视图探测器,以适应不连贯的照明条件的强性. 删除其中之一不会对几何产生有意义的影响。 以非计划式的ZNCC术语而不是计划式的ZNCC完成培训,在精细细节(scan 106)方面有质的改进. 最后,移除正常的平滑名词(eq. 24),比起我们的基模,Chamfer距离略有改善,但也引入了文物(scan 110). 梯度调制(eq.44)不会改变最终结果,而是使训练更加稳定.

blocks.en: 6.4. KNN Efficiency
blocks.zh: 6.4. KNN 效率

blocks.en: We measure the speed of our KNN (K=32) implementation against five baselines on the 4M points DTU checkpoints and present the results in table 5 . For our approach, we distinguish between the case where the ball query search radius is already known (w. warmup) compared to when it is unknown which takes approximately 3 × 3\times longer. In practice, most of the sites can rely on the search radius used in the KNN lookup of the previous training iteration.
blocks.zh: 我们以4M点DTU检查站的5个基线衡量我们KNN(K=32)的执行速度,并将结果见表5。 对于我们的方法,我们区分了已知的球查询半径(w. warmup)与未知的距离(大约需要3×3\时间)的情况。 在实际操作中,大多数站点可以依赖之前训练迭代的KNN检索中使用的搜索半径.

blocks.en: Table 5. KNN timings (ms) on our DTU point clouds with 4M points. The * symbol denotes CPU operations.
blocks.zh: 表5. 我们的DTU点云上的KNN计时(ms)为4M点. *符号表示CPU操作.

blocks.en: MeshlessVoronoi ( Ray et al., 2018 ) and RestrictedVoronoi ( Basselin et al., 2021 ) use the same strategy so we only discuss ( Basselin et al., 2021 ) which was slightly faster. The input points are partitioned on a dense voxel grid as a pre-process. Then, each query point visits the voxels in concentric rings and keeps track of the KNN using a heap in shared memory. Importantly, we doubled their hard-coded maximum search radius to accommodate our adaptive point distributions, otherwise these baselines fail to gather all requested neighbors.
blocks.zh: Meshless Voronoi(Ray等人,2018年)和Restricted Voronoi(Basselin等人,2021年)使用相同的策略,所以我们只讨论(Basselin等人,2021年),速度稍快. 输入点作为预处理在密集的voxel网格上进行分割. 然后,每个查询点访问同心环中的voxels,并在共享内存中使用堆积来跟踪KNN. 重要的是,我们把它们的硬码最大搜索半径翻了一番,以适应我们的适应点分布,否则这些基线无法聚集所有要求的邻居.

blocks.en:
CuPy-KNN ( Igelbrink, ) is a re-implementation of ( Jakob and Guthe, 2021 ) , based on a BVH and using a heap stored in the registers. Torch-kdtree ( Grandits, ) works similarly to Cupy-KNN but builds its acceleration structure on the CPU. Overall, the heap-based approaches are much less efficient than our gather-then-sort approach, even more so when temporal consistency is leveraged.
TrueKNN ( Nagarajan et al., 2023 ) relies on the RT cores of the GPU to benefit from hardware-accelerated BVH traversal. This strategy is effective for uniform point distributions but under performs on our point clouds since several retries are needed for low-density regions. We also include scikit-learn ( Pedregosa et al., 2011 ) as a CPU reference.
blocks.zh:
CuPy-KNN(Igelbrink, )是(Jakob and Guthe, 2021)的重新执行,基于BVH,使用存储在登记册中的堆积. 火炬-kdtree(Grandits,)与Cupy-KNN类似,但在CPU上构建其加速结构. 总体而言,基于堆积的办法比我们收集而成的办法要低得多,在利用时间一致性时更是如此。
TrueKNN(Nagarajan等人,2023年)依靠GPU的RT核心从硬件加速的BVH traversal中受益. 这项战略对统一点分布是有效的,但在我们的点云上却表现不佳,因为低密度地区需要几次复试。 我们还将scikit-learn(Pedregosa等人,2011年)作为CPU的参考.

blocks.zh: 6.5. 沃罗诺伊和德劳奈效率

blocks.zh: 图表 6. 关于我们训练有素的DTU点云(4M点)的沃罗诺伊图建造时间(ms)。

blocks.en: We compare the speed of our algorithm for Voronoi diagram construction against five GPU baselines in table 6 and in figure 14 , on the 4M points DTU checkpoints. Paragram ( Taveira et al., 2026a ) , gDel3D ( Cao et al., 2014 ) and RadiantFoam ( Govindarajan et al., 2025 ) only output the Voronoi adjacency graph. Closer to our approach, MeshlessVoronoi ( Ray et al., 2018 ) and RestrictedVoronoi ( Basselin et al., 2021 ) produce a list of KNN and also compute cell centroids. We ran both of them with single-precision arithmetic and K=32 neighbors, equivalently to our setting. In the case of RestrictedVoronoi ( Basselin et al., 2021 ) , we only report the first round of KNN gathering which corresponds to what we are doing. Subsequent retries with larger K for incomplete cells increase their runtime by about 1.5 × 1.5\times . The reported timing for our approach assumes the KNN search radius is known, to match the typical case encountered during optimization. Overall, our approach is consistently 5 × 5\times faster than ( Ray et al., 2018 ) and 10 × 10\times faster than ( Taveira et al., 2026a ) in this context, and scales linearly.
blocks.zh: 我们比照表6和图14的五个GPU基线, 参数(Taveira等人,2026a),gDel3D (Cao等人,2014年)和RadiantFoam(Govindarajan等人,2025年)只输出沃罗诺伊附图. 更接近于我们的方法,Meshless Voronoi(Ray等人,2018年)和Restricted Voronoi(Basselin等人,2021年)制作了KNN列表,并同时计算细胞百分数. 我们用一个精度的算术 和K=32的邻居 和我们的环境一样 在"限制沃罗诺伊"(Basselin等人,2021年)中,我们只报告第一轮KNN集会,这与我们的行为相符. 之后用更大的 K 为不完全细胞进行重试,使其运行时间增加约1.5×1.5\时. 报告我们方法的时间安排假定已知KNN搜索半径,以配合优化过程中遇到的典型情况。 总体来看,我们的做法始终比(Ray等人,2018年)快5×5\时,比(Taveira等人,2026a)快10×10时,线性尺度。

blocks.en: Table 7. Mesh extraction timings on DTU.
blocks.zh: 表7. DTU上的网格提取时间。

blocks.en: For mesh extraction, we convert the adjacency graph into a Delaunay triangulation (sec. 3.4 ) and subsequently apply marching tetrahedra on the smoothed SDF f ^ \hat{f} . It is sufficient to only generate the tetrahedra that cross the zero level set, which divides the total mesh extraction time by 3 × 3\times according to table 7 . The zero level set is extracted as a triangle soup for real-time visualization during training. The duplicate vertices are merged on the CPU before outputting the final mesh on disk, which takes two seconds in total.
blocks.zh: 对于网格提取,我们将附图转换成Delaunay三角形(sec. 3.4),然后在平滑的SDF f ^\ hat{f}上应用四面体的游行. 仅生成跨越零位集的四赫德拉即可,而零位集将网格总提取时间按照表7除以3×3\时. 零关套被提取为三角汤,用于训练时的实时可视化. 复制的顶点在磁盘上输出最终网格之前在CPU上合并,总共需要2秒.

blocks.en: 7. Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: A limitation of our Voronoi diagram construction algorithm is its approximate nature, which makes it unsuitable for applications requiring exact adjacencies. Iterative retries with a larger number of neighbors in the spirit of Basselin et al. ( Basselin et al., 2021 ) could recover the missing adjacencies. A fallback to double precision could also improve robustness in degenerate configurations.
blocks.zh: 我们的沃罗诺伊图构建算法的一个局限性是它的近似性,这使得它不适合需要精确附图的应用. 依巴塞林等人的精神,与更多的邻居进行迭代式的重试. (Basselin等人,2021年)可以收回缺失的附属物. 反向双精度也可以提高变质配置的稳健性.

blocks.en: As evaluated in the supplementary material, we find the proportion of incomplete cells to be low in practice for our choice of hyperparameters. More aggressive adaptivity could be balanced using a larger number of neighbors but at an increased cost. Deriving theoretical upper bounds on the required number of neighbors based on cell regularity ( Hudson et al., 2006 ) could be useful but may be inapplicable in our case since we make no guarantee on sites spacing.
blocks.zh: 正如补充材料所评价的那样,我们认为,对于我们选择超参数来说,不完全细胞的比例实际上很低。 利用更多的邻国,可以平衡更积极的适应性,但成本增加。 根据细胞规律确定所需邻居数目的理论上限(Hudson等人,2006年)可能是有益的,但对我们的情况可能不适用,因为我们无法保证场地间隔。

blocks.en: Extending our adaptive discretization to open scenes is an interesting direction for future research. The main obstacles are our naive sphere initialization and the potential lack of scalability for representing geometric and photometric details over large spatial extents. The former could be addressed using monocular priors ( Li et al., 2026 ) and the latter could benefit from adaptive densification based on image content ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ; Govindarajan et al., 2025 ) , or primitives with greater expressivity ( Taveira et al., 2026b ) .

blocks.en: 8. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8. 结论

blocks.en: We have presented CVTSplat, an approach for multi-view reconstruction combining adaptive Voronoi tessellations with differentiable implicit surface modeling. Our centroidal regularization plays a central role: beyond producing well-shaped cells, it enables us to specialize several components of the pipeline for efficiency. In particular, we introduced a Voronoi diagram construction algorithm that exploits the regularity of the tessellation. We further tailored neighbor queries, centroid computation, rasterization and mesh extraction to our representation. Together, these developments yield a highly efficient pipeline that achieves geometric accuracy competitive with the state-of-the-art on two object-level reconstruction benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了CVTSplat, 一种多景重建的方法, 结合适应性的Voronioi电讯和不同的隐含表面模型。 我们的中间行星规范化发挥着中心作用:除了产生形状良好的细胞外,它使我们能够专门利用管道的几个组成部分提高效率。 特别是,我们引入了沃罗诺伊图构建算法,利用了纹理的规律性. 我们进一步调整了邻居的查询 中间行星计算 光栅化和网状提取 这些事态发展加在一起,产生了一个高度高效的管道,在两个目标一级重建基准上实现了与最新技术相竞争的几何精确度。

blocks.en: Table 9 reports the average number of topological errors in our extracted meshes. We count the number of non-manifold edges, i.e. edges having more than two incident triangles, and boundary edges that have a single incident triangle. blocks.en: We use a multi-view loss inspired by PGSR ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Pairs of views that are close to each other are chosen at random during training (a mini-batch contains 4 4 views so that pairs can be formed). During the forward pass of volume rendering, the depth of the first zero-crossing of the SDF is recorded for each ray to form a depth map.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了PGSR启发的多视图损失(Chen等人,2024年). 在训练期间随机选择对等的相近观点(一个小批量包含4 4个视图,以便形成对等). 在音量渲染的前传期间,记录了SDF第一次零交叉的深度,每个射线形成深度图.

blocks.en: Once a depth map is obtained for both views in the pair, we can compute our multi-view loss. We implement two variants based on the zero-normalized cross-correlation (ZNCC). The first one is similar to prior works ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Gomez et al., 2026 ) based on planar patches, whereas the other removes the planar assumption to recover finer details.

blocks.en: I.3. Nonplanar ZNCC
blocks.zh: I.3. 非规划ZNCC

blocks.en: Assuming that the surface is locally planar tends to erase fine geometric details so we propose to remove the planar assumption in the ZNCC computation. Doing so is simple, we just use the actual depth of the neighboring pixels in view A, instead of taking the depth of the ray/plane intersection. This amounts to replacing equation 54 by d ′ = 𝒟 A ​ ( u + i , v + j ) d^{\prime}=\mathcal{D}_{A}(u+i,v+j) . In practice, we actually use a separate implementation to take advantage of the fact that the pixel values y i , j y_{i,j} can be shared with neighboring pixels in view A, which is not the case in the planar case due to adjacent pixels having different plane orientations.
blocks.zh: 假设表面是局部平面,往往会抹去精细的几何细节,所以我们提议去掉ZNCC计算中的平面假设. 这样做很简单,我们只是用邻近像素A的实际深度,而不是取射线/飞机交叉点的深度. 这等于用 d ' = D A (u + i, v + j) d prime → mathcal{ D}_{A}(u+i,v+j) 来取代方程式54。 在实践中,我们实际上使用一个单独的执行来利用这样的事实,即像素值y i,j y _{i,j}可以和相邻的像素分享,视像素为A,由于相邻的像素有不同的平面方向,所以平面上的情况并非如此.

blocks.en: We evaluate mutual visibility over each pixel in view A in a similar manner to the planar case. First, by computing the normal as before and checking its angle with respect to both viewpoints, and second, by applying the same cycle consistency check. Invalid pixels or pixels for which the mutual visibility tests fail are skipped in the computation of the moments in equations 56 - 61 .
blocks.zh: 我们以类似Planar案件的方式,评估每个像素上的相互可见度。 首先,通过计算正常情况并检查其对两个观点的角度,其次,采用相同的周期一致性检查。 在计算方程式56 - 61中的时刻时,相互可见度测试失败的无效像素或像素会被跳过 。

blocks.en: I.4. Loss
blocks.zh: I.4. 损失

blocks.en: Our multi-view loss is ℒ MV = ( 1 − ZNCC ) \mathcal{L}_{\text{MV}}=(1-\text{ZNCC}) , summed over all valid pixels in view A. We use the planar ZNCC computation for most of the training since it is more stable, but switch to the nonplanar ZNCC near the end to recover finer details. Note that the grayscale ground truth images and depth maps follow the same coarse-to-fine training regime as the color losses, which means that the small 5 × 5 5\times 5 receptive field will actually cover a larger proportion of the field of view in the beginning.
blocks.zh: 我们的多视图损失是 L MV = (1 – ZNCC )\ mathcal{L}_{\\text{MV}}=(1-\text{ZNCC }),在A视图中以所有有效的像素概括. 我们使用规划ZNCC计算大部分训练,因为它比较稳定,但切换到接近终点的非规划ZNCC来回收更细的细节. 注意灰色尺度的地面真象和深度图遵循了与颜色损失相同的粗细对细训练制度,这意味着小的5×5 5\时的5可接受场实际上会在开始时覆盖更大比例的视野.

blocks.en: I.5. Backward Pass
blocks.zh: I.5. 后退通行证

blocks.en: The ZNCC computation performs the forward and backward passes in the same CUDA kernel for efficiency. It takes as input the depth maps 𝒟 A \mathcal{D}_{A} and 𝒟 B \mathcal{D}_{B} , the grayscale images ℐ A \mathcal{I}_{A} and ℐ B \mathcal{I}_{B} and intrinsic and extrinsic parameters of both cameras. It produces the loss value ℒ M ​ V \mathcal{L}_{MV} along with depth gradients for view A ( ∂ ℒ M ​ V / ∂ 𝒟 A \partial\mathcal{L}_{MV}/\partial\mathcal{D}_{A} ). The depth gradients are further propagated to the SDF values during the backward pass of the volume rendering.
blocks.zh: ZNCC计算在同一个CUDA内核中执行前向和后向的传递,以提高效率. 它以深度地图D\ mathcal{D}_{A}和D\mathcal{D}_{B},灰度图像I\mathcal{I}_{A}和IB\mathcal{I}_{B}以及两个相机的内在和外在参数作为输入. 它产生损失值 L M V\ mathcal{L}_{MV} 以及A视图的深度梯度( QQ L M V /\ D\ 部分\ mathcal{ L}_{MV} /\ 部分\ mathcal{ D}_{A}) 。 深度梯度在卷渲染的后传过程中被进一步传播到 SDF 值 。

blocks.en: J.3. Delaunay Triangulation
blocks.zh: J.3. Delaunay三角形

blocks.en: Assuming points in general position, we prove here that if a tetrahedron is not a Delaunay tetrahedron, then each of its four corners must have a Voronoi neighbor (not necessarily the same) inside its circumsphere.
blocks.zh: 假设一般位置的点,我们在这里证明,如果四面体不是德劳奈四面体,那么其四个角的每个角必须在其环圈内有一个沃罗诺伊邻居(不一定相同).

blocks.en: By contraposition, this will show that a tetrahedron for which any of its four vertices has no Voronoi neighbors inside of the circumsphere must be a Delaunay tetrahedron.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,这将显示一个四面体,其四个顶点中任何一个顶点都没有环圈内Voronoi的邻居,必须是一个Delaunay四面体。

blocks.en: Proof: Assume the tetrahedron IJKL is not a Delaunay tetrahedron. Without loss of generality, we look at corner I. The circumsphere of IJKL contains at least one site strictly inside of it by definition. Let C be the center of the circumsphere and P the offending site: ‖ C − P ‖ < r = ‖ C − I ‖ ||C-P||<r=||C-I|| , with r r the radius of the circumsphere. In other words, C is closer to P than to I, implying that C is not inside the cell of I by definition of a Voronoi cell.
blocks.zh: 证明:假定四面体IJKL不是Delaunay四面体. 没有失去一般性,我们看一角。 IJKL的环圈内至少包含一个按定义严格在它内部的场地. 让C成为环球的中心,让P成为违法地点: ‖ C → P → r = ‖ C → I → || C → P → r → I → || C → r → I → r → || C → r → r → r 的环球半径。 换句话说,C比I更接近P,暗示C按照沃罗诺伊细胞的定义不在I细胞内.

All that remains to show is that Q must be inside the circumsphere of the tetrahedron: (93) ‖ Q − C ‖ 2 \displaystyle||Q-C||^{2} = ‖ Q − I + I − C ‖ 2 \displaystyle=||Q-I+I-C||^{2} (94) = ‖ Q − I ‖ 2 + 2 ​ ( Q − I ) ⋅ ( I − C ) + ‖ I − C ‖ 2 \displaystyle=||Q-I||^{2}+2(Q-I)\cdot(I-C)+||I-C||^{2} (95) = ‖ Q − I ‖ 2 − 2 ​ ( Q − I ) ⋅ ( C − I ) ⏟ > ‖ Q − I ‖ 2 2 + ‖ I − C ‖ 2 \displaystyle=||Q-I||^{2}-\underbrace{2(Q-I)\cdot(C-I)}_{>||Q-I||_{2}^{2}}+||I-C||^{2} (96) < ‖ I − C ‖ 2 = r 2 \displaystyle<||I-C||^{2}=r^{2} We have shown that I I has a Voronoi neighbor Q Q inside the circumsphere, which concludes the proof.
